# Sakib Islam

> Senior WordPress developer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working alone and remotely, with working hours that overlap the US and UK. He fixes, speeds up and maintains WordPress sites for businesses, and builds WordPress sites from Figma designs for design and marketing agencies under their name (white-label). He also built and runs his own SaaS product, Wrkbase.

## Services

- [WordPress maintenance and fixes](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-maintenance/): care plans from $149 a month (updates, backups, security monitoring, a monthly report, small changes); single fixes from $150
- [WordPress speed optimization](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-speed-optimization/): Core Web Vitals, caching, downtime and plugin conflicts, fixed at the cause; from $450 per site
- [WordPress development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/wordpress-development/): custom themes, custom plugins, WooCommerce, payments and integrations; builds from $2,500
- [White-label WordPress development for agencies](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/white-label-wordpress-development/): Figma to WordPress builds, overflow and fixes under the agency's brand; $35 an hour or from $1,200 per site
- [Custom web development](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/custom-web-development/): SaaS products, dashboards, AI agents and fast static marketing sites

## Case studies

- [Tabby](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/tabby/): Figma to WordPress build for an AI bookkeeping product, Core Web Vitals above 90
- [TubeOnAI](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/tubeonai/): a WordPress site that kept going down, fixed; load time from 5 seconds to 1.5
- [Moneybag](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/moneybag/): custom WordPress payment gateway plugin and website
- [Wrkbase](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/wrkbase/): his own SaaS team management platform with an AI agent
- [Open Alliance Learning](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/open-alliance-learning/): WordPress LMS with dashboards for learners, teachers and assessors
- [Piola Pizza](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/piola-pizza/): restaurant website with online ordering in Denmark
- [Pixmge](https://sakib.mywrkbase.com/work/pixmge/): agency website with a quote request flow
